application.description: SO101 sinusoidal joint motion with mock, real-arm, and Isaac Sim (UCX) modes.

mock.description: Run the 100 Hz mock arm with sine-wave joint commands.

profile_real.description: Measure servo speed and acceleration with bounded shoulder-pan steps and CSV feedback.

real.description: Run sinusoidal joint motion on the SO101 Feetech arm.

sim.description: Run sinusoidal joint motion against Isaac Sim over UCX; shows the simulator camera in a Holoviz window when enable_camera is set in the YAML.

application.name: so101_sinus_motion
